title: Wordgard: The new in-browser rich-text editor from the creator of ProseMirror
summary: Wordgard is a new in-browser rich-text editor created by Marijn Haverbeke, the creator of the well-established ProseMirror framework. It represents the next generation of browser-based text editing solutions, building on years of experience from ProseMirror's development.
problem_solved: Provides a modern, well-architected solution for in-browser rich text editing that developers can integrate into web applications.
why_valuable: The creator's proven track record with ProseMirror suggests this new editor will bring improved design and architecture to web-based text editing.
